mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 2.0% signals tight labor markets, prompting investors to anticipate economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 2.0% but 5-day returns remain negative, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand (GDPC1) outpacing supply growth (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on asset prices, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Relative growth of GDPC1 over INDPRO does not correlate with positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05 in t-test), or returns remain below baseline in expansionary gaps.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE), investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises while UNRATE falls but 20-day returns remain positive, or the tightening signal is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 2.0% signals tight labor markets, prompting investors to anticipate economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses below 2.0% but 5-day returns remain negative, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tight labor market, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant correlation between the labor market tightness (PAYEMS/UNRATE ratio) and positive 20-day returns, or returns remain below baseline in such conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (high GDPC1 demand and INDPRO supply), over-supplied goods and robust demand create downward pressure on asset prices, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: High GDPC1 and INDPRO values coincide with positive 60-day returns, or the late-cycle signal lacks statistical significance (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary policy, prompting investors to anticipate higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% but 20-day returns remain positive, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
